en: I turned the key in the door.
I didn't turn my head.
You turned the steering wheel quickly.
You didn't turn the key well.
You (f.) turned the glass toward me.
You (f.) didn't turn your face away from me.
He turned the car at the bend.
He didn't pass the ball to his friend.
She turned her head backwards.
She didn't turn the key in the lock.
We turned the car in the street.
We didn't turn the steering wheel to the right.
You (pl.) passed the ball quickly.
You (pl.) didn't turn your heads.
They turned the key quickly.
They didn't turn the bus on the avenue.
I turn the key every morning.

lat: ma kanduwersh l-volan b yed we7da
en: I don't turn the steering wheel with one hand.
You turn your head slowly.
You don't pass the ball to your friends.
You (f.) turn the key slowly.
You (f.) don't turn your face away when I speak.
He turns the car near the shop.
He doesn't turn the steering wheel in time.
She always turns her head.
She doesn't turn the key properly.
We always pass the ball between us.
We don't turn the car here.
You (pl.) turn the keys in the doors.
You (pl.) don't turn your faces toward the sun.
They pass the ball on the pitch.
They don't turn their heads.
I am going to turn the steering wheel now.
I am not going to turn the key now.
You are going to turn the car at the bend.
You are not going to turn your head.
You (f.) are going to pass the ball to your brother.

lat: ma ghadish tduwri s-sarut f l-bab
en: You (f.) are not going to turn the key in the door.
He is going to turn the glass toward me.
He is not going to turn the car here.
She is going to turn her head to the right.

lat: ma ghadish tduwer s-siyara f l-lil
en: She is not going to turn the car at night.
We are going to pass the ball quickly.

lat: ma ghadish nduwru t-tumubil f had z-znqa
ar: ما غاديش نضورو الطوموبيل فهاد الزنقة
en: We are not going to turn the car in this street.
You (pl.) are going to turn the steering wheel to the left.
You (pl.) are not going to turn the steering wheel here.
They are going to turn the keys now.

lat: ma ghadish yduwru l-kura b z-zerba
en: They are not going to pass the ball quickly.
